key_catalyst: Escalation to an operational Strait of Hormuz blockade amid continued U.S.-Iran strikes and surging oil prices
reasoning: The reported operational Hormuz blockade, third night of U.S.-Iran strikes, sharply reduced shipping traffic, and oil surge are an escalation of the geopolitical shock that drove QQQ’s July 13 risk-off move. The pre-market rebound rests largely on an expected CPI surprise rather than a resolved catalyst, while renewed inflation and tightening concerns plus the semiconductor rout leave the broader threat insufficiently absorbed.
